### Solomon’s Prayer of Dedication
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomons-prayer-of-dedication
Passage: 2 Chronicles 6:12-42
Points:
- Solomon anchors his prayer in God's faithfulness to David while noting that covenant blessing requires obedience.
- Though the highest heavens cannot contain God, He graciously chooses to dwell among and meet with His people.
- The temple was designed as a focal point for repentance, where the Lord hears petitions and grants forgiveness.
- Possession of religious privileges provides no shield against judgment apart from genuine faith and repentance.
- While God is not confined to any building, He actively meets believers whenever they gather in worship.

### Bible Pathways 05/22/04
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-22-or-04-1262436.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 6:14
Points:
- Kneeling and raising hands in prayer demonstrate wholehearted submission, humility, and reverence before God.
- Solomon acknowledges that the Lord is entirely unique, faithfully keeping covenant with those who seek Him.
- Hardship, divine chastening, and failure are often used by God to bring people to repentance.
- Difficult circumstances can lead believers to a deeper, life-changing commitment to the Lord.
- Solomon’s testimony of the incomparable, merciful God points forward to Jesus Christ as Lord and Mediator.
